evidence.decision: Distinguishes a shareable configured system face from unrestricted custom face types, selecting useful complications and compatible alternatives.
evidence.artifact: Delivers configured/sharing artifact, honest preview provenance, app dependencies and device-fallback map.
evidence.transformation: Hiking example replaces universal proprietary-face claims with an actual system-face configuration and comparable older-watch arrangement.
evidence.verification: Checks slot usefulness, preview fidelity, missing apps, incompatible devices and explained substitutions; dishonest previews or dead ends fail.
evidence.applicability: Correctly limits native watch-face scope to watchOS while allowing iPhone configuration/sharing and requiring actual target acceptance tests.
evidence.handoffs: Complications handles slot variants and Designing for watchOS handles wrist task context when those questions arise.
evidence.distinctiveness: System-face configuration identity, framed preview provenance and device substitution distinguish this from arbitrary watch UI design.
